1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; __a remote station in communication with the physiological monitor; and a processor programmed to send an output from the physiological monitor to the remote station that triggers a second alarm, wherein the first alarm and second alarm operate on different escalation timers__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein __the first alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a first timer, and the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a second timer__.

3. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein __an escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is triggered if neither the first alarm nor the second alarm is acknowledged within a predetermined time period__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and __an escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm and is triggered if neither the first alarm nor the second alarm is acknowledged within a predetermined time period__.

6. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to escalate the alarm through multiple escalation stages; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __and escalation stage information__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system __and is configured to track acknowledgement status across multiple alarm stages__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm __and whether the alarm has been acknowledged at each escalation level__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm __including the time of acknowledgement and which station acknowledged the alarm__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __only if the alarm remains unacknowledged after a predetermined escalation period__.
